# Readme Studio by Octacity

> Readme Studio is a browser-based interactive Markdown editor and visual builder designed for creating polished GitHub repository and profile READMEs. Built by Octacity with SolidJS, TypeScript, and Vite.

## Core Resources

- [Readme Studio Web App](https://0ctacity.github.io/readme-studio/): The interactive web application for composing, previewing, and exporting GitHub README documents.
- [Full Agent Documentation](https://0ctacity.github.io/readme-studio/llms-full.txt): Detailed technical guide covering all features, badge generators, profile widgets, and workflow automation.
- [Project README Markdown](https://0ctacity.github.io/readme-studio/README.md): Raw GitHub README documentation with setup and architecture details.
- [Sitemap](https://0ctacity.github.io/readme-studio/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable index of public URLs.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/0ctacity/readme-studio): Source code repository under the Octacity organization.

## Key Capabilities

- Real-Time Markdown Editing: Split-screen editing with sanitized GitHub Flavored Markdown (GFM) preview, local auto-saving, and file drag-and-drop.
- Shields.io & Custom Badges: Configurable live and static badges for CI/CD status, releases, downloads, licenses, and social communities.
- GitHub Profile README Suite: Animated Contribution Snake, Retro Arcade games (Pac-Man, Breakout, Galaga, Puzzle Bobble, Bomberman), Capsule Render banners, GitHub Stats cards, top language widgets, streak counters, and tech stack badges.
- Productivity Utilities: Project directory tree generator and automated slug-linked Table of Contents generation.
- Zero-Server Privacy: Purely client-side execution with local storage persistence and zero telemetry tracking.
